title: ProbeReading
description: The wire envelope of one probe reading: which promise it reads, the @concern: tag that joins it to its a2o scenario and habit, what was observed, the answer, whether the evidence is a fixture or real, who may read it, and when it was observed (interfaces spec §I). `answer` is objects/answer's three-branch envelope (Present takes no reason, Absent only `observed_absent`, Unreachable always a reason), with `value` left unconstrained here: each served promise has ONE monomorphic wire struct in elohim/elohim-views (e.g. MaterializationReadingView) that narrows `answer.value` and is pinned to this schema by its schema_contract test (G6, I8), so no TypeScript generic is needed. A probe with nothing to read emits no reading at all (rendered unmeasured), never a Present answer (spec §9, CONVENTIONS rule 11). The generic seam_contracts::probe::Reading<T> stays internal to Rust; its own serde form (ProbeAnswer externally tagged, a field named `evidence`) is not this wire form. Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; seam_contracts::probe::Reading / EvidenceStage / Disclosure / PartyRole (crates/seam-contracts/src/probe.rs) supply the values, not the wire form, and no test pins them to this schema yet (follow-on: each monomorphic wire struct's schema_contract test in elohim/elohim-views). Source of truth: the probe's own observation (Category C), recomputed by its probe and never persisted as an entity; a holder reading never leaves its holder.

promise.description: The promise kind (spec §9), versioned, e.g. bytes-layer-reads-only-what-is-read@1.

concern.description: The @concern: tag joining the reading to its a2o scenario and habit.

subject.description: What was observed: a root CID, a need key, an app id.

answer.description: The answer envelope; a per-promise wire view narrows `value`.

evidenceStage.description: Fixture or real (finding 16: named evidenceStage on the wire).

disclosure.title: ProbeDisclosure
disclosure.description: Who may read the reading, internally tagged by `disclosure` (values from enums/disclosure). A `holder` reading reaches only a holder sink (the .eprfs/status writer, loopback-only admin routes, loopback-scraped gauges, a worker-local store) and its numbers leave only as an explicit declassification of counts (I7).

openness.description: Reach::openness() of the reach it may be read at (the order of enums/reach).

observedAt.description: Caller-supplied RFC 3339; the probe reads no clock of its own (I12).
